rankedLeadSummary: 1. Debit — Encasadelciegoeltuerco: Triplet guaracha interruptions cut across techno hats; the delayed drop reportedly appears to fall out of time.
2. Debit — Tuve suerte: Broken muscular techno with a trigger-happy synth motif; direct force articulated through a non-straight frame.
3. GRRL — Beetle (Wildlife Hypercolor): A very fast track that reportedly changes position every few beats while retaining a slightly recessed kick.
4. GRRL — Chlorophyll Light Reactor: Published description isolates depth in minute kick bounce and a synth that pushes and pulls.
5. Debit — dystrophica: A short, gurgling and sinister techno-guaracha hybrid approaching psytrance pulsation.
6. Debit — Referencepoint: The opener reportedly becomes increasingly caustic while hurtling toward its end.
7. TAWMAYUI — KID HOD CHU DUB REMIX: A slowed-down dub-techno treatment with khaen melody, glassy pads and reverb-treated percussion.
8. Soup snakeS — ม้าวิ่ง ~ Ma Wing: A galloping cut with stuttering kicks, rough basslines and chopped metallophone patterns that continually intensifies.
9. Lauren Flax — One Man's House is Another Woman's Techno: An overlooked hardware-led acid/electro/techno performance captured through changing drum-machine patterns.
